generation.reproducibility: Using the same seed and generation settings produces identical generated datasets.

datasets.purpose: Customer records associated with insurance policies and claims.
Insurance policy records, including policy details and lifecycle information.
Coverage details and limits associated with policies.
Reported incidents associated with insurance claims.
Claim submissions and their reported details.
Individual items and amounts associated with claims.
Claim documents and their availability or verification status.
Insurance adjuster records used in the claims workflow.
Settlement records, including intentionally seeded anomalies.
Claim lifecycle and audit event records.
Reference labels for intentionally seeded anomalous claims.
Records the generation seed, date, and dataset counts.
Records the outcome and key counts from data validation.
